grammar.label: articles with place names and institutions
grammar.form: go to school vs go to the school
grammar.meaning: the institution as a purpose against the building as a place

explanation.en: No article when you mean the purpose: 'She is in hospital' (as a patient). Use 'the' for the building: 'He is at the hospital' (visiting).
explanation.uz: Maqsad nazarda tutilsa artikl qo'yilmaydi: 'She is in hospital' (bemor sifatida). Bino haqida bo'lsa 'the': 'He is at the hospital' (ko'rgani borgan).

grammar.positive_example: He went to prison for two years; I went to the prison to visit him.
grammar.negative_example: He went to the prison for two years as a prisoner.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q; bu farq faqat ma'no orqali o'rganiladi.

grammar.label: nouns that change meaning when countable
grammar.form: experience vs experiences; work vs works
grammar.meaning: one word, two meanings, split by countability

explanation.en: 'Experience' uncountable is knowledge you have gained; 'experiences' countable are separate events. The same split runs through paper, time, room, business.
explanation.uz: Sanalmaydigan 'experience' — to'plangan bilim; sanaladigan 'experiences' — alohida voqealar. Xuddi shu farq paper, time, room, business so'zlarida ham bor.

grammar.positive_example: She has ten years of experience and some unusual experiences.
grammar.negative_example: She has ten years of experiences.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada bunday bo'linish yo'q, shuning uchun ko'plik shakli noto'g'ri ishlatiladi.
